//: A real record, captured from the CEF index on 2026-10-16 when a Windows fetch resolved it. It is kept because it is the shape that broke the resolver: a version entry is an object carrying cef_version, channel, chromium_version and files, not a version string. The list it came from is ordered newest first, and this 2016 build was its last element - so taking the last element picked it, and formatting it into the archive name produced a URL full of JSON that the download refused.
//why-kept: tools/fetch_cef.py --self-test uses this to prove the resolver still reads this shape and still chooses a modern build over it.
